tcs.test_item:
The software shall automatically adjust daylight saving time based on time zone rules
(confirm the displayed time shifts forward when the DST boundary is crossed)
tcs.pre_conditions:
The vehicle is an Atlantis High architecture variant
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to ON
GPS signal is available
Ignition is ON
The current position is in a time zone that observes daylight saving time
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
2. PENDING: DR-10 使車輛時間跨越 DST 切換點（進入日光節約時間）之操作方式
3. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU display shows the standard local time
2. The vehicle time has crossed the daylight saving start point
3. The HU display shows the local time advanced by one hour with no user action
tcs.design_method: 情境 / 用例 (Scenario / Use Case Testing)
tcs.reasoning: 4813995 逐字：The daylight saving time shall be adjusted automatically。**依 R-TM60，無使用者操作之 DST 開關**（該三條常數已刪除），故觸發為時間跨越切換點。前置條件明訂位置所在時區採行 DST —— 4813995 之「依時區規則」隱含此前提。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall automatically adjust daylight saving time based on time zone rules
(confirm the displayed time shifts back when the DST period ends)
tcs.pre_conditions:
The vehicle is an Atlantis High architecture variant
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to ON
GPS signal is available
Ignition is ON
Daylight saving time is in effect at the current position
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
2. PENDING: DR-10 使車輛時間跨越 DST 切換點（結束日光節約時間）之操作方式
3. Read the time shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU display shows the daylight saving local time
2. The vehicle time has crossed the daylight saving end point
3. The HU display shows the local time set back by one hour with no user action
tcs.reasoning: 4813995 之另一方向。**兩個方向各一條** —— 自動調整之進入與退出為不同之狀態轉換，以其一代替另一會使覆蓋只有一半（同 018 之 reset/battery 二觸發）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall allow manual date setting and update internal counters when GPS sync is disabled
(confirm the date can be entered manually while GPS sync is disabled)
tcs.pre_conditions:
The cluster does not have the data needed to reference the date
Ignition is ON
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to OFF
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Set Date Day", "Set Date Month" and "Set Date Year" to 09 / 03 / 2035
3. Read the date shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. The date entry is accepted
3. The HU display shows 09/03/2035
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-12b 設定頁名（Clock 或 Clock & Date）待確認
tcs.reasoning: 4814012：使用者經 HU 設定選單設定日期；4814000：無 GPS 時提供手動輸入方式。UI 項名 `Set Date Day` / `Month` / `Year` 取自 HMI Settings List 第 7 節（`11` T4），**有正式來源故不寫 DR-12 佔位**。 **顯示前提**：HMI Settings List R1L-R 2026-02-13 §7-6 之註記逐字為 `[NOTE:  Set Dateis only shown for vehicles in which the cluster does not have data needed to reference date]`（原文 typo `Set Dateis` 照錄）。其與 4814000（`If the HU has No GPS, the HU … shall provide a manual method using HMI to enter date`）同向 —— 二者皆以「他處無日期來源」為手動設定之前提。**措辭不超出該二來源**：只述 cluster 無資料，不推論其成因，亦不加 GPS 之條件（4814000 之 No GPS 為 HU 側，與 cluster 側非同一事）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall allow manual date setting and update internal counters when GPS sync is disabled
(confirm the manually entered date is sent on the bus)
tcs.pre_conditions:
The cluster does not have the data needed to reference the date
Ignition is ON
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to OFF
The CAN bus is awake
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Set Date Day", "Set Date Month" and "Set Date Year" to 25 / 12 / 2033
3. Read $DateTmDay$ in TELEMATIC_FD_1.Day1_TLM / TELEMATIC_FD_1.Day2_TLM on FD and record it
4. Read $DateTmMonth$ in TELEMATIC_FD_1.Month1_TLM / TELEMATIC_FD_1.Month2_TLM on FD and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. The date entry is accepted
3. $DateTmDay$ carries 2 in Day1_TLM and 5 in Day2_TLM
4. $DateTmMonth$ carries 1 in Month1_TLM and 2 in Month2_TLM
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-12b 設定頁名（Clock 或 Clock & Date）待確認
tcs.reasoning: 4814001 逐字列出 $DateTmYear$ / $DateTmMonth$ / $DateTmDay$ 三訊號。日期各欄在 Atl-H 為 4-bit 數位對（`11` §3.3.1），故 25 表為 2 與 5。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 406 / 411（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。 **顯示前提**：HMI Settings List R1L-R 2026-02-13 §7-6 之註記逐字為 `[NOTE:  Set Dateis only shown for vehicles in which the cluster does not have data needed to reference date]`（原文 typo `Set Dateis` 照錄）。其與 4814000（`If the HU has No GPS, the HU … shall provide a manual method using HMI to enter date`）同向 —— 二者皆以「他處無日期來源」為手動設定之前提。**措辭不超出該二來源**：只述 cluster 無資料，不推論其成因，亦不加 GPS 之條件（4814000 之 No GPS 為 HU 側，與 cluster 側非同一事）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall allow manual date setting and update internal counters when GPS sync is disabled
(confirm the year is sent across its four digit signals)
tcs.pre_conditions:
The cluster does not have the data needed to reference the date
Ignition is ON
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to OFF
The CAN bus is awake
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Set Date Year" to 2033
3. Read $DateTmYear$ in TELEMATIC_FD_1.Year1_TLM / TELEMATIC_FD_1.Year2_TLM / TELEMATIC_FD_1.Year3_TLM / TELEMATIC_FD_1.Year4_TLM on FD and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. "Set Date Year" shows 2033
3. $DateTmYear$ carries 2, 0, 3 and 3 across Year1_TLM to Year4_TLM
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-12b 設定頁名（Clock 或 Clock & Date）待確認
tcs.reasoning: $DateTmYear$ 在 Atl-H 為**四個** 4-bit 數位（LID 表 Format 欄：4 bits each / digit 1–4），與時 / 分 / 日 / 月之兩位數位不同。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 413（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。 **顯示前提**：HMI Settings List R1L-R 2026-02-13 §7-6 之註記逐字為 `[NOTE:  Set Dateis only shown for vehicles in which the cluster does not have data needed to reference date]`（原文 typo `Set Dateis` 照錄）。其與 4814000（`If the HU has No GPS, the HU … shall provide a manual method using HMI to enter date`）同向 —— 二者皆以「他處無日期來源」為手動設定之前提。**措辭不超出該二來源**：只述 cluster 無資料，不推論其成因，亦不加 GPS 之條件（4814000 之 No GPS 為 HU 側，與 cluster 側非同一事）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall allow manual date setting and update internal counters when GPS sync is disabled
(confirm the internal date counters follow the manual entry)
tcs.pre_conditions:
The cluster does not have the data needed to reference the date
Ignition is ON
"Sync Time with GPS" is set to OFF
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the "Clock" settings
2. Set "Set Date Day", "Set Date Month" and "Set Date Year" to 01 / 01 / 2032
3. Turn the ignition to OFF
4. Turn the ignition to ON
5. Read the date shown on the HU display and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Clock" settings open
2. The date entry is accepted
3. The ignition is OFF
4. The ignition is ON and the HU starts up
5. The HU display shows 01/01/2032
tcs.design_method: 情境 / 用例 (Scenario / Use Case Testing)
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-12b 設定頁名（Clock 或 Clock & Date）待確認
tcs.reasoning: 4814013：依 Day/Month/Year Setting.Info 更新內部日期計數（條件為 GPS 自動調整未設定）；4814014：HU_Date.Info 等於計數值。以點火循環後仍保有該值驗證計數已更新，而非只有畫面暫存。 **顯示前提**：HMI Settings List R1L-R 2026-02-13 §7-6 之註記逐字為 `[NOTE:  Set Dateis only shown for vehicles in which the cluster does not have data needed to reference date]`（原文 typo `Set Dateis` 照錄）。其與 4814000（`If the HU has No GPS, the HU … shall provide a manual method using HMI to enter date`）同向 —— 二者皆以「他處無日期來源」為手動設定之前提。**措辭不超出該二來源**：只述 cluster 無資料，不推論其成因，亦不加 GPS 之條件（4814000 之 No GPS 為 HU 側，與 cluster 側非同一事）。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall send SNA/default values when time/date data is invalid or unavailable
(confirm SNA is sent in the time signals when reliable data is unavailable)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is awake
tcs.test_procedure:
1. PENDING: DR-20 使 HU 無法送出可靠時間資料之操作方式
2. Read $DateTmHour$ in TELEMATIC_FD_1.Hour1_TLM / TELEMATIC_FD_1.Hour2_TLM on FD and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU is unable to send reliable time data
2. $DateTmHour$ carries the SNA value defined for that signal
tcs.design_method: 基礎故障注入 (Fault Injection Lite)
tcs.reasoning: 4813905 逐字：If the ECU can not send reliable data, the ECU (including gateway) shall send SNA (Signal Not available) values in the destination signal。**本條驗 SNA 送出規則本身（屬 022）**，不驗 GPS 值之送出正確性（屬 014，B-2 界線）—— 故受測訊號取時間訊號而非 GPS 訊號。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 409（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。 canon §4.5 / R-TM66：本欄原載之資料為互動操作，屬 Procedure。

tcs.test_item:
The software shall send SNA/default values when time/date data is invalid or unavailable
(confirm the default value is sent when no SNA value is defined for a signal)
tcs.pre_conditions:
Ignition is ON
The CAN bus is awake
tcs.test_procedure:
1. PENDING: DR-20 使 HU 無法送出可靠時間資料之操作方式
2. Read $DateTmDay$ in TELEMATIC_FD_1.Day1_TLM / TELEMATIC_FD_1.Day2_TLM on FD and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU is unable to send reliable date data
2. $DateTmDay$ carries the default value specified in the CAN database
tcs.reasoning: 4813905 之第二子句：if no SNA value is defined, it shall be set to the default value. The default values are specified in the CAN database。$DateTmDay$ 之 SNA 欄在 LID 表為空（`11` §3.3.2：19 個 LID 中僅 $DateTmFormat$ 有 SNA 值），故適用此子句。**期望值指向 CAN database 而不自擬**。 訊號三件組之 MESSAGE 與 segment 取自 LID 表 Atlantis High (col 26-30) 欄，來源列 406（A-TM26 之強制記錄）。 canon §4.5 / R-TM66：本欄原載之資料為互動操作，屬 Procedure。
